items.title: Delivery Options
items.description: How it gets there: one ruled list of delivery methods, each with its arrival dates and price. Arrival is a date range from business days and a dispatch cut-off on the shopper's own clock, worked out after hydration so the server never guesses their time zone, with a countdown to the cut-off on the chosen method. Prices are right-aligned tabular figures and a free method says Free. Unavailable methods give their reason in words; loading and empty states included. The heavy rule slides to the chosen method (Motion; a fade under reduced motion).
